new-games-a.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate a transparent sprite sheet using the attached Princess Amber canonical as the exact character reference. Preserve her warm fair complexion, very large brown eyes, flowing auburn hair, delicate orange-gold crown with centered flower jewel, and her long bright golden-orange princess gown decorated with large white daisies and dark navy trim. Preserve same face, proportions, crown, hair length, dress pattern, and navy-outlined cel-shaded finish in every cell. Exactly EIGHT separate full-body poses arranged in FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, read left-to-right then next row; one complete figure per cell, consistent head size and body proportions, three-quarter view facing right, generous transparent gutters, complete crown/hair/dress hem/hands in each cell. Row 1: (1) tug-of-war ready: braced feet beneath gown, torso leaning back to the left, both empty hands together reaching forward-right at waist height gripping an invisible rope, determined happy grin; (2) tug heave: leaning farther back left, knees bent under skirt, same empty grip forward-right, joyful exertion; (3) fishing reel ready: leaning slightly back, forward hand gripping invisible rod just above chest height, other hand beside it ready to crank, gaze right; (4) fishing reel crank: same planted stance and forward grip, other hand moved inward/down to crank an invisible reel, cheerful focused smile. Row 2: (5) overhead bat-swing windup: both empty hands together above right shoulder/overhead, legs braced, delighted face; (6) bat-swing follow-through: both empty hands moved forward-right and upward above face as the strike finishes, happy grin; (7) putting ready: side-on facing right, knees softly bent, looking down-right, both empty hands joined low in front/right at thigh height holding an invisible putter; (8) putting follow-through: same stance, low empty hands swung slightly forward-right, looking up-right hopefully. Full figure shapes all fit. Do not draw rope, rod, fishing line, bat, putter, ball, scenery, ground, shadows, effects, text, labels, panels or frames. Transparent background.

new-games-b.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate a transparent sprite sheet using the attached Princess Amber canonical as the exact character reference. Preserve her warm fair complexion, very large brown eyes, flowing auburn hair, delicate orange-gold crown with centered flower jewel, and her long bright golden-orange princess gown decorated with large white daisies and dark navy trim. Preserve same face, proportions, crown, hair length, dress pattern, and navy-outlined cel-shaded finish in every cell. Exactly FOUR separate full-body poses arranged in ONE horizontal row, read left-to-right; one complete figure per cell, consistent head size/body proportions, three-quarter view facing right, generous transparent gutters, complete crown, hair, hands and full dress hem in each cell. (1) spring-jump: launching joyfully upward, both arms straight up, knees tucked beneath flying skirt, feet lifted, big grin and happy upward gaze; (2) snow-scoop: deeply crouched close to ground, both empty hands together low in front/right, curved palms packing an invisible snowball, focused cheerful face, feet planted; (3) dig: low crouch, legs spread slightly under gown, torso leaning forward/right, both hands scooping down between legs then back toward left, gleeful focused face, feet planted; (4) skip-hop: light two-footed jump-rope hop, knees tucked a little, both arms extended out to sides at waist/chest height, joyful face, feet lifted. Keep gown recognizable and pose anatomy plausible, full figures fit. Do not draw snowball, tools, rope, clouds, ground, shadows, effects, labels, words, borders or background. Transparent background.

landmarks: Initial crop-local estimates; must be checked on runtime review overlays before checkpoint approval.

review.method: Inspected coordinate-grid exports of all 12 generated cells and placed source-cell-local points directly on visible features; reviewed transformed markers on actual-size runtime overlay.
review.landmarks: head at skull/hair top, eyes at mean visible eye centers, neck at visible neckline, back on torso/back plane, hand at actual grasp point or palm, anchor at visible sole/ground contact; crouch pose height preserved.
correctedAfterRootReview: reel hand on raised forward rod-grip hand, not lower crank hand
putt and putt-swing hands on low clasped hands
skip-hop hand on actual outstretched right palm
eye points adjusted to average visible eye centers
skip-hop hand moved from arm/space to outstretched viewer-right palm
